synopsis: The integrated build installs and runs on the iPhone over Wi-Fi with Codex as the primary provider. The home opening card, route overlay, undo/redo and persistence work on the device. Three gaps matter most. First, the core's hazard actions (shade a room, layer up, escape, account outside, refuge arrival, move to a shaded room) never reach the native rehearsal UI, so most of the requested scenario-lead checks cannot be performed, and the live director can recommend actions the user cannot take. Second, the director stalls: an adaptive session sat at minute 0 with Next and End disabled after an operation returned needs_client_tools. Third, a 2 USD default spend window cut off live Prepare coverage early in the session. Several regression tests fail because the flows changed (setup-first rehearsal entry, the hospital-category filter, the moved county picker), and the alert banner component has no call site in this build.
fact_findings: hh-lake heat: the director used the heat-sensitive Grandma and cooling facts, and recommended an action (room shading) with no native control: an unsupported affordance.
hh-pine tornado manufactured home: the director and scene correctly treat the closet as non-refuge and point to the missing advance shelter plan.
hh-lake Prepare after the switch: the live Beacon section raised a question tied to the refrigerated medication's storage facts. No Oak facts appeared.
hh-oak Where to meet: the backup meetup (Abilene, out of area) is shown in the Nearby neighborhood slot, which misreads the meetup's role.

failures.diagnosis: HazardExperience feasible commands (reduceSolarGain, warmLayers, escape, accountOutside, refuge arrival, heat moveTo proposals) are not referenced anywhere in apps/ios/DryRun. ExerciseActions offers only water, power allocation (when compatibleBackupIDs exist), contact, helper and fire door actions. The lead's six-hazard branches are therefore not playable on the phone.
failures.fix: Render HazardExperience.feasibleCommands as accepted actions in AdaptiveRehearsalView and PracticeCheckView, with localized titles. Check that hh-oak's oxygen concentrator exposes its battery station allocation in freeze.

failures.diagnosis: DeviceAudit adaptive apartment-complex fire: the director operation returned needs_client_tools and the app never continued it. The session stayed at +0h00m with Next and End disabled for more than 20 s. The probe runs showed the same disabled-Next pause after the first advance.
failures.fix: Add a client deadline that commits the local director's step when the Beacon director has not finished. Keep End always enabled. Make sure client-tool continuation is triggered.

failures.diagnosis: The gateway's default DRYRUN_MAX_USD=2 owner window was used up within about 4 Prepare calls. Every later Prepare Beacon request returned owner_window_quota, so the phone silently showed the non-live path for most of the session.
failures.fix: Raise the cap for reviewer sessions (or set it in .env), and show the quota state in the gateway log and in a reviewer-visible receipt.

failures.diagnosis: AlertBannerCard has no call site. The call site exists only on branch dryrun-six-hazard-continue (commit 2a9d974), so -demoAlert and the live NWS banner never render (PREP-17).
failures.fix: Port the Prepare call site, or retire the inventory entry.

failures.diagnosis: Settings > Try a sample family > Load this family, with the same family (Oak) already loaded, left Prepare on 'Running all six practice scenarios' with no action list for more than 2.5 minutes, twice. Switching to a different family (Lake) completed promptly.
failures.fix: Investigate the recompute when reloading the active example: likely a cancelled or duplicate recompute that never resolves. Add a timeout and retry.

failures.diagnosis: The opening card allows an interior door (pt-living-hall) to lead Outside. It immediately becomes an exterior EXIT and routes use it.
failures.fix: Only offer Outside for an opening on an exterior wall, or require a confirm step and mark the result unverified until confirmed.

failures.diagnosis: The Relationship picker value truncates mid-word at accessibility sizes in en, es and vi (PREP-08 and the family editor).
failures.fix: Stack the picker label and value, or use a navigation-link picker at accessibility sizes.

failures.diagnosis: Where to meet labels the Oak backup (out-of-area) meetup as the Nearby neighborhood meeting place.
failures.fix: Map the meetup roles explicitly: backupMeetingPlace must not fill the neighborhood slot.

failures.diagnosis: MapRequestTests: the fake hospital results have no category, so the new hospital-category filter drops one of them. DemoJourney address journey: the rehearsal now opens setup first, and the test never taps rehearsal.setup.start. DemoJourney describe: the county picker is no longer on the first setup screen. SixHazard fire and tornado: an answered decision leaves an unresolvable decision.option match, so the harness tap fails while Next step stays enabled. Practice check: no decision.option is reachable at the expected moment.
failures.fix: Update the tests to the current flow and fixtures. Retest the practice-check flow for a real regression.

failures.diagnosis: The Plan map list still shows 'Let Gemini plan these searches' while Codex is primary. At accessibility size in es, the map sheet's safety disclaimer is truncated with an ellipsis.
failures.fix: Use a provider-neutral label. Let the disclaimer wrap.

The Codex-served claim rests on gateway access-log timing plus Codex runtime records with a model id. The gateway does not log the serving provider per request, and other agents may have run Codex concurrently.
Home checks used the editor list entry rather than tapping the plan, and VoiceOver was not exercised.
